verse_renderings.text: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that what has happened to me has actually helped spread the good news.
As a result, it has become obvious to the entire palace guard and to everyone else that I am in prison because of Christ.
And my imprisonment has given most of the brothers and sisters new confidence in the Lord, so that they now dare to speak God’s message even more boldly, without fear.
Some preach about Christ because they are jealous and want to compete. Others preach with good intentions.
Those who preach out of love know I have been given the task of defending the good news.
The others preach about Christ only to advance themselves. Their motives are not sincere, and they think they can make my suffering in prison worse.
But what does that matter? The important thing is that Christ is being preached, whether the motives are false or sincere. And in that I take great joy. Yes, I will continue to be full of joy.

authority.decision: Replace Philippians 1:13 with: “As a result, it has become obvious to the entire palace guard and to everyone else that I am in prison because of Christ.” Retain every other word in Philippians 1:12–18.
authority.instruction: Audit this exact selected wording without pre-audit repair. Auditors provide evidence only; the human editor alone decides whether any finding warrants a change.

audit_request.reason: Required sealed-candidate audit after common-goal process revalidation and human selection.
audit_request.note: Harmless retrigger after the workflow-creation push produced no associated run.

revision.prior_wording: Everyone in the imperial guard, and everyone else, now knows that I am in prison because of Christ.
revision.selected_wording: As a result, it has become obvious to the entire palace guard and to everyone else that I am in prison because of Christ.
revision.scope: Only verse 13 changed; verses 12 and 14–18 retained exactly.

approval.scope: Philippians 1:12–18 as sealed, including the revised verse 13 and unchanged verses 12 and 14–18.
